ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.2 Lean Pool is an allocation-focused refinement of JS1.1 Lean for RimWorld 1.5. It preserves the successful JS1 nearest-order search semantics, HasJobOnThing parity sampling, ReachProfile authority, WorkPrefilter, haul accelerators and Path shadow policy. JS1.2 recycles the main-thread per-JobPackage PackageContext and moderate ThingBucket dictionaries so backing storage can be reused instead of repeatedly allocated; oversized buckets are discarded rather than retained. HasJobOnThing Harmony hooks use typed Pawn/Thing/bool arguments instead of the generic __args array on the millions-of-calls hot path, and the current WorkGiver bucket has a reference fast path before dictionary lookup. Conservative package-local admission may stop only NEW cache stores for buckets that remain below 0.5% reuse after a large probe window; existing cached entries can still hit and uncached calls always run Vanilla. ShouldSkip and HasJobOnCell memoization remain removed, RegionHint remains retired, and no Job, reservation, JobOnThing/JobOnCell result or mutable game state is cached. No cache survives the JobPackage boundary and no worker wait is introduced.
